metadata.description: Checks that a bnto release actually shipped: crates.io serves the version for every crate a release publishes, a published GitHub Release exists for its tag, and www.bnto.io shows it. Every check reports even after one fails. Run it from the repo root after a release: task release:verify -- X.Y.Z.

version.label: Version
version.description: The released version, X.Y.Z without the v (e.g. 0.18.0).

parameters.script:
# release-verify, crates.io: every crate a release publishes at the shared
# workspace version serves it. $1 the version. Run from the repo root.
# Gap: an http-request node will replace curl here (dogfooding.md, PR 10).
die() { echo "release-verify: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
version=${1-}
# An unset field reaches the step as its literal template (a missing value
# should stop the run first; dogfooding.md follow-ups), so treat it as unset.
case $version in '' | *'{{'*) die "give the version: -p version=X.Y.Z" ;; esac
printf "%s\n" "$version" | grep -Eq "^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+$" || die "bad version '$version' (want X.Y.Z, no v)"

missing=""
for toml in engine/crates/*/Cargo.toml; do
  if ! grep -q '^version.workspace = true' "$toml" || grep -q '^publish = false' "$toml"; then continue; fi
  crate=$(sed -n 's/^name = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' "$toml" | head -n 1)
  if curl -fsS -o /dev/null -A "bnto release-verify (https://github.com/Develonaut/bnto)" "https://crates.io/api/v1/crates/$crate/$version"; then
    echo "  ok       crates.io serves $crate $version"
  else
    missing="$missing $crate"
    echo "  MISSING  crates.io has no $crate $version"
  fi
done
[ -z "$missing" ] || die "crates.io has no$missing at $version"

# release-verify, GitHub: a published release (not a draft or prerelease)
# exists for the version's tag. $1 the version.
# Gap: an http-request node will replace curl here (dogfooding.md, PR 10).
die() { echo "release-verify: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
version=${1-}
# An unset field reaches the step as its literal template (a missing value
# should stop the run first; dogfooding.md follow-ups), so treat it as unset.
case $version in '' | *'{{'*) die "give the version: -p version=X.Y.Z" ;; esac
printf "%s\n" "$version" | grep -Eq "^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+$" || die "bad version '$version' (want X.Y.Z, no v)"

release=$(curl -fsS -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" "https://api.github.com/repos/Develonaut/bnto/releases/tags/v$version") || die "GitHub has no release for v$version"
printf '%s\n' "$release" | grep -Eq '"draft": *false' || die "the v$version release is still a draft"
printf '%s\n' "$release" | grep -Eq '"prerelease": *false' || die "the v$version release is a prerelease"
echo "  ok       GitHub Release v$version is published"

# release-verify, bnto.io: the home page's install demo shows the version,
# so production deployed this release. $1 the version.
# Gap: an http-request node will replace curl here (dogfooding.md, PR 10).
die() { echo "release-verify: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
version=${1-}
# An unset field reaches the step as its literal template (a missing value
# should stop the run first; dogfooding.md follow-ups), so treat it as unset.
case $version in '' | *'{{'*) die "give the version: -p version=X.Y.Z" ;; esac
printf "%s\n" "$version" | grep -Eq "^[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+$" || die "bad version '$version' (want X.Y.Z, no v)"

page=$(curl -fsSL https://www.bnto.io/) || die "www.bnto.io didn't answer"
printf '%s\n' "$page" | grep -qF "$version" || die "www.bnto.io doesn't show $version yet"
echo "  ok       www.bnto.io shows $version"
